preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_class index_relation JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index index_state ON index_state.indexrelid = index_relation.oid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace index_schema ON index_schema.oid = index_relation.relnamespace WHERE index_schema.nspname = current_schema() AND index_relation.relname = 'uk_dimension_definition_tenant_domain_name_ci' AND NOT index_state.indisvalid

changeSet.comment: A failed CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY leaves an invalid index relation. Recheck this cleanup on every Liquibase run so repeated failures remain recoverable without dropping a valid index.

preConditions.onFailMessage: DIMENSION_DEFINITION_NAME_CONFLICT_AUDIT_REQUIRED: duplicate tenant/domain/lower(name) groups exist. Run the audit query from this changeset; rename the incorrect definition, or explicitly delete it after proving zero usage, then rerun Liquibase.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, domain_id, lower(name) FROM modeling_dimension_definition GROUP BY tenant_id, domain_id, lower(name) HAVING count(*) > 1 ) conflicts

SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_class index_relation JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index index_state ON index_state.indexrelid = index_relation.oid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace index_schema ON index_schema.oid = index_relation.relnamespace WHERE index_schema.nspname = current_schema() AND index_relation.relname = 'uk_dimension_definition_tenant_domain_name_ci' AND NOT index_state.indisvalid

changeSet.comment: Prevent concurrent duplicate names in one tenant/domain. Precondition audit query: SELECT tenant_id, domain_id, lower(name), array_agg(id ORDER BY created_date, id) FROM modeling_dimension_definition GROUP BY tenant_id, domain_id, lower(name) HAVING count(*) > 1. Operators must explicitly choose which semantic definition to retain and rename the others, or delete them only after proving zero usage; this migration never merges definitions by name. Canonical index signature: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_dimension_definition_tenant_domain_name_ci ON modeling_dimension_definition (tenant_id, domain_id, lower(name)); it is created concurrently below.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS uk_dimension_definition_tenant_domain_name_ci ON modeling_dimension_definition (tenant_id, domain_id, lower(name));
